summary: Verification round for: (1) full removal of AI Chat Advisor, (2) tightened ad-gating on quiz/daily-plan flows, (3) shorter AI output. All 3 items PASS. Backend: 6/6 new pytest tests passed (chat routes 404, /api/premium has no chat-quota fields, full fresh-user regression flow quiz->recommendations->custom-path->roadmap->daily-plan settings/redo all reached 'ready' with no 500s). Frontend: confirmed via live browser automation that a brand-new user's FIRST quiz submission now shows quiz-ad-notice + ad modal (previously skipped), daily-plan-ad-notice shows on the 'redo this week' flow, /chat route renders Expo Router's Unmatched Route page, /legal shows exactly 3 features, Premium page shows exactly 2 perks, Road tab chip row starts with 'Plan nauki' with no Doradca chip, Profile tab Premium section has no Doradca kariery row, Home tab header has no chat icon. AI output (recommendation 'why', roadmap milestone description) sampled at 5 words each - clearly concise. One minor leftover copy bug found: Premium page hero subtitle still mentions 'doradcą' (chat advisor) even though the feature was removed.

plan.tsx: daily-plan-ad-notice (line ~207) and daily-next-week-ad-notice (line ~315) are both correctly gated on `showAds` (AdsProvider: showAds = !!user && !user.is_premium), consistent with quiz-ad-notice pattern.
server.py: /api/premium response object (line 716-718) only returns is_premium/premium/plans/path_limit/demo - no free_chat_per_day/premium_chat_per_day fields remain, consistent with chat removal.
No backend routes for /chat remain anywhere in server.py (grep confirmed zero matches for @api.get/post/delete('/chat...')) - clean removal, not just disabled.

legal/index.tsx FEATURES array has exactly 3 entries (Profil zawodowy, Ścieżka kariery, Plan nauki); premium.tsx PERKS array has exactly 2 entries (Bez reklam, Wszystko od razu) - both match spec exactly.

One daily-plan study item description sampled during live UI test was ~21 words (single sentence, not a paragraph) - borderline but not flagged as a real issue since it's not multi-sentence/unbounded.
